title: One commercial street, two dates

pair.inspection_note: Commercial street: matching parking structure and warehouse facade. Viewpoint/framing differ; needs frontage-level alignment.

matching_landmarks: large multi-story parking structure on left side
white building on right side with partial 'ANDERSON HOLLYWOOD' lettering

observations.earlier_evidence: large multi-story parking structure with open sides and some signage visible on adjacent building
observations.later_evidence: same multi-story parking structure visible with same open side design and adjacent building with similar size
observations.interpretation: No significant structural changes visible to the large parking structure and adjacent buildings on the left side.

observations.location: right side of street near foreground
observations.earlier_evidence: white building with 'ANDERSON HOLLYWOOD' partially visible, some trees and a metal fence enclosing area
observations.later_evidence: same white building with partial 'ANDERSON HOLLYWOOD' lettering, more dense tree foliage obscuring signage and fence
observations.interpretation: The building is the same, but dense tree growth partially obscures the signage and fence, causing uncertainty in detailed comparisons here.

observations.earlier_evidence: median with yellow curb and some low bushes or plants, and road surface with lane markings and cracked pavement
observations.later_evidence: road with similar lane markings and cracks visible, no median plants on this portion though median is visible far ahead
observations.interpretation: Street median and road condition appear consistent with no clear change visible in the central part of the street.

limitations: Tree growth obscures some signage and fences on the right side in the later photo.
Different lighting and shadows in the two images obscure some finer details.
Camera angles and slight framing shifts limit visibility of some parts of buildings and street.

review_notes: Model observations have not been independently human-reviewed.
Different foliage visibility does not establish tree growth; viewpoint and seasonal effects remain possible.
Camera positions are close, but framing differs. Compare only overlapping buildings, not whole-image pixels.
This pair does not establish business turnover, displacement, or current neighborhood conditions.
